title: Wire oscore-fork provisioning into fuzz/interop/ec2-arm64/mutation workflows
description: Same defect class as mbzu: fuzz.yml, interop.yml, ec2-arm64.yml, mutation.yml also run cargo in the rust workspace but have no step materializing rust/oscore-fork, so [patch.crates-io] path dep fails at manifest load on fresh runners. Composite action .github/actions/oscore-fork already exists (created for ci.yml); add '- uses: ./.github/actions/oscore-fork' after checkout in each cargo job. Verify each workflow's working-directory/cd layout and fuzz-crate isolation before wiring.
